title: Mock2 manifest-backfill resolution (mock2_integration_resolutions, kind=manifest_backfill)
description: PATCH B.1. An append-only, content-hashed record that an operator declared an undeclared external capability by committing a manifest entry to state/integrations.json. The resume re-runs the gate against it (an `undeclared` finding becomes a real-provenance check), breaking the deadlock. Historical records are never rewritten.

cycle_id.description: the blocked cycle this resolution acted on

manifest_id.description: the id of the committed manifest entry

manifest_hash.description: content hash of the committed entry (a change re-opens verification)

routed_to.description: the resume returns to building so the gate re-runs against the declaration
